using namespace std;

const int MAXC = 400;
int cap[MAXC][MAXC];

int dy[4] = {0, 1, 0, -1};
int n, t;
int shortest[15][15][15][15];
int reach[13][13], treach[13][13];

int getnode(int x, int y) {
    return (x - 1) * n + y - 1;
}

void expand(int val) {
    memcpy(treach, reach, sizeof(reach));
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (treach[i][j] == val) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                    int ni = i + dx[k];
                    int nj = j + dy[k];
                    if (ni > 0 && nj > 0 && ni <= n && nj <= n && treach[ni][nj] < val && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                        reach[ni][nj] = val;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

bool canreach(int sx, int sy, int tx, int ty, int ix, int iy) {
    memset(reach, 0, sizeof(reach));
    reach[sx][sy] = 1;
    reach[ix][iy] = 2;
    int iters = 100;
    while (iters--) {
        expand(1);
        if (reach[tx][ty] == 1) return true;
        expand(2);
        if (reach[tx][ty] == 2) return false;
    }
    return false;
}

bool bfs(int src, int sink, int parent[]) {
    memset(parent, -1, MAXC * sizeof(int));
    queue<int> q;
    q.push(src);
    parent[src] = src;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front();
        q.pop();
        for (int v = 0; v <= sink; v++) {
            if (parent[v] == -1 && cap[u][v] > 0) {
                parent[v] = u;
                if (v == sink) return true;
                q.push(v);
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    memset(shortest, 1, sizeof(shortest));
    cin >> n >> t;
    int infx = 0, infy = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cin >> (scien[i] + 1);
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            shortest[i][j][i][j] = 0;
            if (scien[i][j] == 'Z') {
                infx = i;
                infy = j;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        cin >> (reac[i] + 1);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int ni = i + dx[k];
                int nj = j + dy[k];
                if (ni > 0 && ni <= n && nj > 0 && nj <= n && scien[i][j] != 'Y' && scien[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                    shortest[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int kx = 1; kx <= n; kx++) {
        for (int ky = 1; ky <= n; ky++) {
            for (int sx = 1; sx <= n; sx++) {
                for (int sy = 1; sy <= n; sy++) {
                    for (int tx = 1; tx <= n; tx++) {
                        for (int ty = 1; ty <= n; ty++) {
                            shortest[sx][sy][tx][ty] = min(shortest[sx][sy][tx][ty],
                                                           shortest[sx][sy][kx][ky] + shortest[kx][ky][tx][ty]);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int src = n * n * 2 + 1;
    int sink = n * n * 2 + 2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
            if (isdigit(scien[i][j])) {
                cap[src][getnode(i, j)] = scien[i][j] - '0';
            }
            if (isdigit(reac[i][j])) {
                cap[n * n + getnode(i, j)][sink] = reac[i][j] - '0';
            }
            if (isdigit(scien[i][j])) {
                for (int a = 1; a <= n; a++) {
                    for (int b = 1; b <= n; b++) {
                        if (scien[i][j] > '0' && reac[a][b] > '0' && isdigit(reac[a][b]) &&
                            shortest[i][j][a][b] <= t && canreach(i, j, a, b, infx, infy)) {
                            cap[getnode(i, j)][n * n + getnode(a, b)] = 1000;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int flow = 0;
    int parent[MAXC];
    while (bfs(src, sink, parent)) {
        int bottleneck = 1000000000;
        for (int v = sink; v != src; v = parent[v]) {
            int u = parent[v];
            bottleneck = min(bottleneck, cap[u][v]);
        }
        for (int v = sink; v != src; v = parent[v]) {
            int u = parent[v];
            cap[u][v] -= bottleneck;
            cap[v][u] += bottleneck;
        }
        flow += bottleneck;
    }
    cout << flow << '\n';
    return 0;
}
